assumptions: Only open orders are included; cancelled orders are ignored.
Order dates are inclusive within the requested date range.
Product aliases and unit conversions must be present and unique in the supplied policy table.
Quantities and conversion factors are whole numbers and are represented as safe integers.
Each demanded product must have one inventory row for the requested warehouse.
The inventory snapshot must not be later than the requested end date.
Shortage is max(demand in each minus on-hand quantity, zero).
This seed program was authored for development and has not been generated from live Nemotron trajectories.
